note: Suggests bad things are coming. Ranges from apprehension to terror. Attracts evil and opposes faith, hope, and love.
Dulls desire for true knowledge. Promotes indifference and blind foolishness.
Blocks clear sight and dulls discernment. It makes obvious truth feel hidden or distant.
Questions what God has said and weakens confidence. It pulls a person away from trust and obedience.
Creates disorder in thought and decision-making. It makes simple things feel tangled and uncertain.
Presses down on joy, energy, and hope. Torments with darkness and heaviness. Suggests self-harm.
Stirs quarrels, suspicion, and broken unity. It turns attention inward and poisons relationships.
Brings weakness, sickness, and disease. It makes a person feel less able to stand or recover.
Makes lies seem trustworthy and hides what is true. It dresses danger up as something harmless or good.
Presses a person with need, limitation, and shortage. It narrows options and can pull the heart toward fear.
Makes a person feel exposed, stained, or unworthy. It tries to silence confidence and belonging.
Fixes attention on guilt and failure. It says the past defines you and that mercy is out of reach.
Resists faith even when truth is present. It makes promises feel unreal and power feel distant.
Pulls desire toward what should be avoided. It promises satisfaction while hiding the cost.
Makes the future look closed and the battle look pointless. It speaks defeat before the fight is over.
Feels like too much at once. It crowds the mind and body until clarity and peace are hard to keep.
Lifts the self above correction, mercy, and dependence on God. It hardens the heart against wisdom.
